title: Add Pollinations for Obsidian to writing
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pollinations for Obsidian](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/pollinations-obsidian) to writing
- An Obsidian plugin that generates text and images with Pollinations inside the user's notes, on the user's own Pollen. **What it does** - **Text from a prompt or the selection.** The command asks for 

Fixes #15711, fixes #15574

gist.headline: Notes with room to grow
gist.blurb: Pollinations for Obsidian brings text and image generation into your notes. Give it a prompt or select some text, and keep writing without leaving your vault.
gist.summary: Added Pollinations for Obsidian to the writing app listings; the plugin generates text from a prompt or selection and creates images inside Obsidian notes using the user's own Pollen.
gist.impact: Obsidian users can find a plugin that brings Pollinations text and image generation into their notes, with usage charged to their own Pollen.
gist.visual_concept: Depict an Obsidian-style purple crystal beside an open pixel notebook, with a text passage and a small generated picture on its pages. Polli, wearing a tiny writer's scarf, helps tend a code-plant growing from the notebook; the scene represents a community plugin rather than a new API feature.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art writing nook, an open notebook beside a dark-purple Obsidian-style crystal holds a short text passage and a little landscape picture, while lime green (#ecf874) code-plants bloom around it. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, wearing a tiny writer's scarf and tending the notebook's sprouting code-plant, strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, and the emotionally warm lo-fi feel of Stardew Valley or A Short Hike.
